'''Annileen Calwell''', (née '''Thaney''') nicknamed '''Annie''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|storekeeper]] who lived in [[Dannar's Claim]], in the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]]. The widow of [[Dannar Calwell]], she was also the mother of [[Kallie Calwell|Kallie]] and [[Jabe Calwell|Jabe]], and a friend of [[Leelee Pace]]. She did not like her teenage son Jabe hanging around with [[Orrin Gault]] and his posse as she feared he would get injured or [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Tusken Raider]]s.

After [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] delivered [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to his uncle [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] and his [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|wife]], he settled down close to where Annileen was dutifully running [[Dannar's Claim]], a general store her late husband left in the Pika Oasis. Kenobi's oddity intrigued her initially. Through brief but eventful interactions, she developed feelings for Kenobi. However, after a showdown involving Orrin's posse, she found her position in the oasis untenable due to her perceived connection with Orrin, who had embezzled the oasis.

Though she had hoped her future would involve Obi-Wan, he prepared Annileen and her family to leave Tatooine immediately. She learned that her old college application was mysteriously accepted by the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]], which was a dream of her younger years.
